newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends easier, enters new lower range.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends easier, enters new lower range.

text.p: 1540 GMT - The Swiss franc closed easier against the dollar and has likely entered a new, lower range for the next week.
Dealers now look for the franc to fluctuate between 1.3470 to 1.3530/40 after it pulled back from a low of 1.3515. Trading was very thin, dominated by retail customers, dealers said.
Volatility can be expected next week with many dealers first returning January 6. * Dollar closes at 1.3481/3486 francs vs 1.3430/3430 opener and Christmas Eve closer of 1.3407/3413 on Tuesday.
The franc also closed easier against the mark with the current range seen from 86.50 to 86.80 centimes. * Mark closes at 86.68/71 centimes vs 86.42/47 opener.
